schema:
CREATE TABLE circuits (
  alt,
  circuitId,
  circuitRef,
  country,
  lat,
  lng,
  location,
  name,
  url
);

CREATE TABLE constructorResults (
  constructorId,
  constructorResultsId,
  points,
  raceId,
  status
);

CREATE TABLE constructorStandings (
  constructorId,
  constructorStandingsId,
  points,
  position,
  positionText,
  raceId,
  wins
);

CREATE TABLE constructors (
  constructorId,
  constructorRef,
  name,
  nationality,
  url
);

CREATE TABLE driverStandings (
  driverId,
  driverStandingsId,
  points,
  position,
  positionText,
  raceId,
  wins
);

CREATE TABLE drivers (
  code,
  dob,
  driverId,
  driverRef,
  forename,
  nationality,
  number,
  surname,
  url
);

CREATE TABLE lapTimes (
  driverId,
  lap,
  milliseconds,
  position,
  raceId,
  time
);

CREATE TABLE pitStops (
  driverId,
  duration,
  lap,
  milliseconds,
  raceId,
  stop,
  time
);

CREATE TABLE qualifying (
  constructorId,
  driverId,
  number,
  position,
  q1,
  q2,
  q3,
  qualifyId,
  raceId
);

CREATE TABLE races (
  circuitId,
  date,
  name,
  raceId,
  round,
  time,
  url,
  year
);

CREATE TABLE results (
  constructorId,
  driverId,
  fastestLap,
  fastestLapSpeed,
  fastestLapTime,
  grid,
  laps,
  milliseconds,
  number,
  points,
  position,
  positionOrder,
  positionText,
  raceId,
  rank,
  resultId,
  statusId,
  time
);
